mainEntity.name: What is involved in upgrading a kitchen's hot water supply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading a kitchen's hot water supply can involve installing an under-sink instant hot water dispenser or, for more extensive needs, upgrading your main water heater. Instant dispensers provide immediate hot water at the tap, ideal for cooking or cleaning. A new tankless water heater, for instance, can offer a continuous supply and improved energy efficiency for the entire home. We can help you assess your current system and recommend the most suitable upgrade for consistent hot water availability and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrading involves installing an instant hot water dispenser for the tap or upgrading the main water heater for continuous, energy-efficient supply. We help assess and recommend options.
